 Intro

VComponents is a SwiftUI collection that contains reusable UI components.

 

For additional info on component customization, refer to "Customization" documentation.

For additional info on animations, refer to "Animations" documentation.

For additional info on modal components, refer to "Modal Presenter" documentation from VCore.

 Compatibility

 Platform and Version Support

Package provides limited macOS , tvOS , watchOS , and visionOS support.

Versions with different majors are not directly compatible. When a new major is released, deprecated symbols are removed.

 Versioning

 Major . Major changes, such as big overhauls

 Minor . Minor changes, such as new components and customization options

 Patch . Bug fixes and improvements

 Contributing

 Branches

 main contains the latest release. dev contains work towards the next release, and may undergo major changes, especially ahead of a new major release in September.

 Bug Fixes . Open a PR against main . Small fixes may be released as a patch directly from main . Less urgent fixes, or ones that overlap with ongoing work, may be retargeted to dev and released with the next version. Fixes that require unreleased changes in VCore should target dev , as only dev depends on VCore's dev .

 Features and API Changes . Open an issue first, then a PR against dev .

 Code Style

Match the style of the surrounding code. Package doesn't include tests, so PRs shouldn't add them. Changes may be adjusted before merging.

 Contact

e-mail: vakhtang.kontridze@gmail.com

 Maintainer Resources

Links and local paths for the maintainer's own tooling. You don't need any of this to use or contribute to the library.

Paths are written as ${KEY} . Each key is defined in README.local.md , not committed, one per machine, as KEY = "path" lines sorted alphabetically. If a key isn't defined, the resource isn't available locally, so use the link instead.
